Failure modes include overconfidence in high-probability plays, misalignment of risk-reward ratios, and insufficient adaptation to opponent behavior. Dualities emerge in the symmetry between offensive and defensive roles, where each side's actions define the other’s constraints. The system exhibits non-linear dynamics through feedback loops involving field position, time remaining, and score differential.
